manifest.purpose: Test-only repair of per-fixture schema and version-option consumption, with native controls and required source gates.

counterfactual.description: The published hardcoded reader with only its exact count adjusted from 30 to 32, plus two appended case records. It retains all 30 original fixtures and unchanged reader logic. This is a count-adjusted test-reader counterfactual, not a production source repair.

previous_verification.scope: Exact prior production/source evidence and original fixture contracts. No old full source gate substitutes for the required gates in this job.
previous_verification.report_serialization: The artifact uses the immutable native writer json.dumps(report, indent=2) plus LF with default ensure_ascii=True. The durable projection uses literal UTF-8 for six U+00E9 characters. Require both exact byte hashes, parsed equality and native serialization equality.

compiled_query_values.qualified-version-select-time: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.version time FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'

compiled_query_values.qualified-version-returning-time: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING items.version time
compiled_query_values.relation-qualified-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT version.version FROM items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-join-on-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i JOIN items j ON j.version = i.id) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-where-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items i WHERE version = 0) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-function-argument: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n FROM items i, LATERAL generate_series(0, i.version) seq(n)) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-distinct-from-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 0 IS DISTINCT FROM version FROM items i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-function-from-operand: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT substring('abc' FROM version + 1) AS value FROM items i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-using-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i JOIN items j USING (version)) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.relation-array-on-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i JOIN items j ON ARRAY[1, i.version] = ARRAY[1, 0]) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
compiled_query_values.fixture-counter-column: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.counter time FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'
